title: Add Profile entity
description: Room entity for a caregiver's profile (person or pet) that medications are logged against on a shared device.
acceptance_criteria: @Entity(tableName = "profiles") data class Profile with an autoGenerate Int primary key id
Fields: name: String, kind: ProfileKind = ProfileKind.PERSON, phoneNumber: String? = null, colorTag: String? = null, isArchived: Boolean = false, createdAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
